objective: Repair the browser-use headless launcher: signal handling across the whole run, the port race, process-group cleanup, environment scrubbing and the review notes.
scope: Worktree /home/user/holyagent-0.3.2-browser-use (branch release/0.3.2/feat/browser-use, head b0ba7eb1; the change under repair is cb82345). The review findings are restated below.

1 (blocking). packages/runtime/src/pi/browser-launch.ts: SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP handlers exist only inside host.interrupted, raced after the server started; a signal during the DevTools poll (up to 20 s) or the server spawn ends the launcher with no cleanup, leaving the detached Chromium (own process group, unauthenticated CDP port) and the temp dir. A second signal during stopGroup's grace has the same effect. Install the handlers for the whole run, from the start of runBrowserServer to the end of cleanup (for example an acquireRelease at the top that interrupts the main fiber), keep them during cleanup so a repeated signal does not kill cleanup, and add tests that signal while Chromium is still starting and during cleanup, asserting Chromium stop and directory removal.

2. Port race (code note and security #3): freePort probes, closes, then Chromium binds; another local process can take the port and answer /json/version, and browser-use then attaches to a browser it controls. Launch Chromium with --remote-debugging-port=0 and read the port Chromium actually bound from DevToolsActivePort in the profile directory (first line is the port), then poll that port; drop freePort if nothing else needs it. Test with fakes.

3. stopGroup (browser-launch.ts:223-224) returns early when the leader exited, so helpers left in its process group are never signalled; signal the group regardless (ignore ESRCH). On win32 use taskkill /T /F for the tree at once rather than only after the grace times out, or explain why not. Add tests for the real host's stopGroup and interrupted where they can run without a real Chromium (spawn a short-lived Bun or shell child as the stand-in).

4. Environment (security #5): serverEnvironment passes the whole inherited environment to the uvx child, so UV_INDEX, UV_EXTRA_INDEX_URL, UV_FIND_LINKS, PIP_*, PYTHONPATH can redirect the package source and every provider API key reaches browser_exec's Python. Pass an allowlisted environment instead: PATH, HOME, USER, LOGNAME, SHELL, TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP, LANG, LC_*, TZ, TERM, the proxy variables HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY/ALL_PROXY in both cases, SSL_CERT_FILE, SSL_CERT_DIR, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE, UV_CACHE_DIR, UV_NATIVE_TLS, and on Windows SystemRoot, SystemDrive, WINDIR, ComSpec, PATHEXT, USERPROFILE, APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA, ProgramData, ProgramFiles; then the HolyAgent-set variables (BU_CDP_URL, BU_NAME, ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=0, the temp state dirs) on top. Keep the list in one named constant with JSDoc stating why; test that a UV_INDEX, PIP_INDEX_URL, PYTHONPATH and an OPENAI_API_KEY-style secret do not reach the child while PATH and the proxy and CA variables do. Chromium's own env is not part of this item.

5. packages/runtime/src/setup/chromium.ts: PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_EXECUTABLE_PATH was renamed to HOLYAGENT_CHROMIUM_PATH with no fallback, and a value in the variable is never checked for existence, so doctor passes and the failure shows only at launch. Read PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_EXECUTABLE_PATH as a fallback when HOLYAGENT_CHROMIUM_PATH is unset (document it as the old name), and make findChromium/doctor report a configured path that does not exist as missing with the fix. Tests.

6. docs/pi/screen.md: say plainly that browser_exec runs arbitrary Python on the host with the server's (allowlisted) environment, not only on the DevTools connection, so a screen specialist has host code execution as it had with the Playwright server's run-code tool; that the DevTools port has no authentication, so on a host shared with other local accounts another user could drive the browser; and that Chromium runs with --no-sandbox when HolyAgent runs as root (cloud images). Keep it short and in the doc's existing style.

Make no git writes (no commit, add, checkout, stash, branch) and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; the root commits. Report your changed paths.

Follow the repository rules in .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md of the worktree: Effect for effects and errors with tagged errors (no try/catch, new Promise, Promise statics or async functions in runtime and CLI source), Effect Schema at data boundaries with onExcessProperty error, Bun APIs and the Bun Shell, JSDoc on every exported function and type.

Testing is unit tests and fakes only: never start pi, a Pi session, T3 Code, browser-use, uvx or a real Chromium, and make no live Kimi, Codex or OpenAI request; a short-lived Bun or sh child as a process stand-in is fine.

Gates, run in your worktree: `bunx --no-install mise run build` (commit-ready generated output; the tree must have no unexplained changes after it) and `bunx --no-install mise run verify` (type-check, lint, format check, tests) must exit 0. Give the command, exit code and test counts.

Write `git diff` of your change (after the build) to a file outside the repository in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad and give its path as diff-file evidence.
Build only what the Assignment asks; name any further improvement in the report instead of adding it.
Report in under 500 words; put long logs in a file in the scratchpad above and give its path.

criteria.text: A termination signal at any point from launch to the end of cleanup still stops Chromium and removes the temp directory, with tests for a signal during startup and during cleanup
The DevTools port is the one Chromium reports in DevToolsActivePort, so another process cannot pre-bind the probed port
stopGroup signals the whole process group even after the leader exited, and the real host's stopGroup and interrupted are tested
The uvx child gets an allowlisted environment that drops UV_INDEX, PIP_*, PYTHON* and secrets while keeping PATH, proxy and CA variables, with a test
findChromium reads PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_EXECUTABLE_PATH as a fallback and reports a configured path that does not exist
docs/pi/screen.md states browser_exec's host code execution, the unauthenticated DevTools port on shared hosts and --no-sandbox as root
mise run build leaves no unexplained changes and mise run verify passes
